meaning: to meet (a requirement); to conform to

senses.en: to meet (a requirement); to conform to

examples.zh: 这个办法符合我们的要求。
examples.en: This method meets our requirements.

examples.zh: 你的条件不符合这个工作。
examples.en: Your qualifications don't fit this job.

examples.zh: 他说的符合事实吗？
examples.en: Does what he said match the facts?

meaning: just in case; if by any chance

senses.en: just in case; if by any chance

note: Introduces an unlikely, unwelcome possibility; stronger than 如果.

examples.zh: 带上伞吧，万一下雨呢。
examples.en: Take an umbrella, just in case it rains.

examples.zh: 万一我迟到了，你们先开始吧。
examples.en: If I happen to be late, go ahead and start without me.

examples.zh: 多带一点儿钱，万一不够呢。
examples.en: Bring a bit more money, in case it isn't enough.

examples.zh: 他有很多老唱片。
examples.en: He has a lot of old records.

examples.zh: 这张唱片是去年出的。
examples.en: This album came out last year.

examples.zh: 我想买一张她的新唱片。
examples.en: I want to buy her new album.

note: For people, 胖 is the usual word; 肥 fits meat, animals, or clothes that are too big.

examples.zh: 我不喜欢吃肥肉。
examples.en: I don't like eating fatty meat.

examples.zh: 这条裤子有点儿肥，有小一点儿的吗？
examples.en: These pants are a bit loose; do you have a smaller size?

examples.zh: 那只猫很肥。
examples.en: That cat is quite plump.

meaning: to be aimed at; to target

senses.en: to be aimed at; to target

examples.zh: 这个活动是针对老人的。
examples.en: This event is aimed at older people.

examples.zh: 他的话是针对我说的吗？
examples.en: Was he saying that about me?

examples.zh: 医院针对这个问题开了会。
examples.en: The hospital held a meeting on this problem.

examples.zh: 孩子很怕打针。
examples.en: Children are very afraid of getting shots.

examples.zh: 医生给他打了一针，他就好多了。
examples.en: The doctor gave him a shot, and he felt much better.

examples.zh: 我需要一根针和一些线。
examples.en: I need a needle and some thread.

meaning: to fill in (a form); to fill

senses.en: to fill in (a form); to fill

examples.zh: 请先填一下这张表。
examples.en: Please fill in this form first.

examples.zh: 这个地方你还没填。
examples.en: You haven't filled in this spot yet.

examples.zh: 他填完表就交给了老师。
examples.en: He handed the form to the teacher once he'd filled it in.

note: Common pattern: 既…又… / 既…也… (both… and…).

examples.zh: 这家店的菜既好吃又便宜。
examples.en: The food at this shop is both tasty and cheap.

examples.zh: 她既会唱歌，也会跳舞。
examples.en: She can both sing and dance.

examples.zh: 他既不抽烟，也不喝酒。
examples.en: He neither smokes nor drinks.

examples.zh: 他往旁边一闪，车就过去了。
examples.en: He dodged to the side and the car went past.

examples.zh: 我昨天打球时闪了腰。
examples.en: I sprained my back playing ball yesterday.

examples.zh: 前面有人，快闪开！
examples.en: There's someone ahead; get out of the way, quick!

examples.zh: 这次会议的主题是什么？
examples.en: What is the theme of this meeting?

examples.zh: 他的文章主题很清楚。
examples.en: The theme of his article is very clear.

examples.zh: 我们说一说这个主题吧。
examples.en: Let's talk about this topic.

examples.zh: 周末大家聚一聚吧。
examples.en: Let's all get together this weekend.

examples.zh: 过年的时候，全家人都聚在一起。
examples.en: At the New Year, the whole family gathers together.

examples.zh: 老朋友很久没聚了。
examples.en: We old friends haven't gotten together in a long time.

note: As a verb, 列出 means "to list out"; also a classifier for rows, columns, and trains.

examples.zh: 请把要买的东西列出来。
examples.en: Please list the things you need to buy.

examples.zh: 他列了一个学习计划。
examples.en: He drew up a study plan.

examples.zh: 这张表一共有五列。
examples.en: This table has five columns in total.

examples.zh: 外面下雨，我的鞋都湿了。
examples.en: It's raining outside and my shoes are all wet.

examples.zh: 衣服还是湿的，先别穿。
examples.en: The clothes are still wet; don't put them on yet.

examples.zh: 这里天气很湿，衣服不容易干。
examples.en: The weather here is damp, so clothes don't dry easily.

examples.zh: 他把所有财产都留给了孩子。
examples.en: He left all his property to his children.

examples.zh: 房子和车都是他们的共同财产。
examples.en: The house and the car are their joint property.

examples.zh: 他没有什么财产，只有一间小房子。
examples.en: He doesn't have much property, only a small house.

note: Used for casual groups; can sound slightly negative, like "gang".

examples.zh: 门口站着一伙人。
examples.en: A group of people is standing at the door.

examples.zh: 那伙年轻人是来旅游的。
examples.en: That group of young people came to travel.

examples.zh: 我们是一伙的，你放心吧。
examples.en: We're on the same side, so don't worry.

note: Written or formal; in speech people usually say 可是 or 但是.

examples.zh: 他很努力，然而结果不太好。
examples.en: He worked hard; however, the result wasn't very good.

examples.zh: 这个方法很简单，然而很有用。
examples.en: This method is simple, yet very useful.

examples.zh: 我们等了很久，然而他还是没来。
examples.en: We waited a long time, but he still didn't come.

note: Mostly part of compounds (移动, 移民); on its own it is a bit formal.

examples.zh: 请把桌子往左移一点儿。
examples.en: Please move the table a bit to the left.

examples.zh: 请把车移到旁边。
examples.en: Please move the car to the side.

examples.zh: 太阳慢慢地移到了山后面。
examples.en: The sun slowly moved behind the mountain.

note: Mostly a building block (引起 cause, 吸引 attract); alone it appears in 引路, 引来, 引出.

examples.zh: 请你给我们引一下路。
examples.en: Please show us the way.

examples.zh: 这个故事引出了一个大问题。
examples.en: This story raised a big question.

examples.zh: 他的话引得大家都笑了。
examples.en: His words made everyone laugh.

examples.zh: 为了避免迟到，我六点就起床了。
examples.en: To avoid being late, I got up at six.

examples.zh: 多洗手可以避免生病。
examples.en: Washing your hands often helps you avoid getting sick.

examples.zh: 这种错误是可以避免的。
examples.en: This kind of mistake can be avoided.

note: More formal than 马上; common in notices and work messages.

examples.zh: 看到消息后，请立即回复我。
examples.en: Please reply to me immediately after you see this message.

examples.zh: 发现问题要立即告诉老师。
examples.en: If you find a problem, tell the teacher right away.

examples.zh: 他听到电话响，立即跑了过去。
examples.en: He heard the phone ring and ran over at once.
